sentences.text:
Petitioners thereafter had submitted representations,
however, no decision has been taken on the same and therefore direction be issued to decide the representation within specified time.

2. Learned counsel for respondent submits that as petitioners are seeking a direction to the respondent authorities to decide the representation at the earliest, she is having no objection to the limited prayer made by counsel for the petitioners.
3. I have heard counsel for the parties and perused the documents annexed with the writ petition.
4. Documents Annexure-P1 enclosed a notification issued under Section 3G of the National Highways Act, 1956.
Petitioners have not submitted any documents of the proceedings thereafter.

5. Be that as it may, as the respondent No.3 has already issued notification under Section 3G, I am of the view that no useful purpose will be served in keeping this writ petition pending, awaiting response from respondents, instead it will be in the interest of the parties to dispose of the case directing respondent No.3 to take decision on the claim of the petitioners /representation dated 06.04.2023 at the earliest.
6. Consequently, this writ petition is disposed of directing respondent No.3 to take decision on the representation submitted by petitioners in accordance with law expeditiously.
